winner.text: Add a video-by-tab categorical interaction to learn surface-specific item appeal.
winner.rationale: Tab is request-time available and positively screened as part of request context. The large validation weakness on tabs 0 and 6 indicates that a global video effect may be insufficient when the same candidate is scored on different surfaces.
winner.exact_ablation: Append exactly one hashed categorical feature representing the pair (video_id, tab) to experiment 1's additive feature matrix; keep the existing individual fields, BCE objective, optimizer, and stopping rule unchanged.

expected_effect.nDCG@5: +0.001 to +0.004 because the ablation directly targets surface-specific top-rank errors.

selection_rationale: c02 is the strongest scarce-experiment choice: it has the highest consultant rank and utility (rank 1, 78), the highest expected primary gain among the low-risk single-feature candidates (0.0020), and higher confidence than c01 (6 vs. 5). It directly extends the only empirically positive screened family, request context (+0.00221 primary across all internal temporal-holdout days), with a candidate-specific mechanism that can correct surface-dependent item ordering. It targets materially weak, sufficiently large validation tabs 0 (13,726 rows; GAUC 0.5419, nDCG@5 0.0621) and 6 (5,170 rows; GAUC 0.5708, nDCG@5 0.1052), while preserving the proven baseline scorer, BCE training recipe, and low leakage/runtime risk. This is a more reliable and attributable improvement than broader architecture or loss replacements.
